neighbours.label: the auxiliary of a perfect tense (has / have / had / 've, French a), with its 'not' or 'now'
fire: Results for the second quarter have not been published so far.
Whales were once common along this coast. Today, they have been hunted out.
Le seuil critique a changé depuis la dernière étude.
Two statues have since been built near the square.
The battery may be dead, or corrosion has occurred on the terminals.
Une nouvelle route a ouvert ses portes depuis juin.
The old bridge has now been replaced by a tunnel.
Most of those species had vanished by the time he arrived.
quiet: Results for the second quarter are not public so far.
